integrity: Derived analytic claims checked against rational identities using verify.py; proof and self-review only, not independent certification or publication.
scientific_limitations: Scalar Ornstein–Uhlenbeck equation; iid independent positive finite-support time steps; exact arithmetic; theta in [0,1]; mean-square contraction assumed. Infinite-fourth example uses occasional step beyond fixed-step stability range; an exact moment cutoff but no precise distributional tail asymptotic or pathwise divergence proved. Inaccessible 2022 stochastic-theta random-step paper is residual priority risk.
title: Sharp Gaussianity and fourth-moment boundaries for randomly stepped stochastic theta schemes
